runners_data.name: Jacks Bridge
runners_data.comment: The Irish Rover gelding, half-brother to bumper winner but likely best watched
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1 and failed to beat a rival in Punchestown maiden hurdle last month; tongue-tie goes on; impossible to fancy.

runners_data.name: Mytommy
runners_data.spotlight: Castle Du Berlais gelding; half-brother to winners Enrichissant (2m4f hurdle/chase), Bambouzle (1m4f-1m7f AQPS Flat) and Don't Hesitate (12.5f/1m5f AQPS Flat and 2m hurdle); dam placed 1m4f-1m7f AQPS Flat; worth a market check on debut.

runners_data.name: Neat As A Pin
runners_data.spotlight: Homebred Getaway filly; sister to point winner Sound As A Bell; dam point winner, closely related to high class jumpers Follow The Plan and Ballychorus; nicely bred and needs checking in the market on debut.

runners_data.name: Tex Amare
runners_data.comment: Showed ability when second in a 1m2f maiden at Munich last October, decent Flat pedigree
runners_data.spotlight: Showed ability on sole start on the Flat in Germany at Munich (1m2f, soft) last October; that form isn't easy to assess and she is hooded for her hurdling debut; worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Who's Da Goose
runners_data.comment: Brother to point winner More Than A Mule; best watched
runners_data.spotlight: 100-1 and weakened into a 37l seventh of 14 on debut at Killarney (2m1f gd-yld); seems safe to rule out after that.

runners_data.name: Cinating
runners_data.comment: Has made the frame in three bumpers, should go close with an adequate round of jumping
runners_data.spotlight: Decent level of form in bumpers (including on testing ground); in the process of running a big race on hurdles debut at Ballinrobe when falling two out; should go well here if that hasn't dented her confidence; hood goes on.

runners_data.name: Ritz Plan
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in all three starts in academy hurdles on testing ground for Joesph O'Brien; off since 2.25l second at Naas in December (2m1f, sft-hvy); could go well on first run for new yard.

runners_data.name: Mike Des Mottes
runners_data.comment: Solid debut effort behind a subsequent Punchestown winner; get involved with more to come
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fourth in Leopardstown bumper on debut in March (2m, sft-hvy); failed to back it up when tailed off at Kilbeggan (2m1f, gd-yld); half-brother to a hurdles winner and return to softer ground a likely plus.

runners_data.name: Betterluckthistime
runners_data.comment: Non-runner
runners_data.spotlight: 100-1 and ran like it on debut in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle in April; unlikely.

runners_data.name: Take The Free
runners_data.comment: Brother to 2m3f hurdle winner That's Nice; tailed off over slightly shorter trip here
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off at big prices both starts; well beaten on debut at Cork (16.5f, yielding) but much better when a 7l sixth of 14 in another maiden hurdle (17.5f, good) back there on latest; place claims if backing that up but softer ground a query (dam won on soft-heavy).

runners_data.name: Dont Break My Word
runners_data.comment: Tailed off a long way from home on debut at Sligo, can be ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in maiden hurdles at Sligo and Ballinrobe; fourth last time but 25l behind the winner; will probably be seen to better effect when handicapping.

runners_data.name: Tribal
runners_data.comment: 80-1 and failed to figure on debut at Killarney, may need more time
runners_data.spotlight: Unlikely winner based on heavy maiden hurdle defeats at Killarney and Ballinrobe.

runners_data.name: Teffian Warrior
runners_data.comment: Second reserve; wouldn't be the obvious answer on hurdle debut with stamina to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Modest Flat maiden rated 64; not an obvious candidate for hurdling on breeding; tongue-tie added to cheekpieces; likely best watched.

runners_data.name: God The Highness
runners_data.comment: Placed twice last year inc' here, shaped ok in maiden hurdle latest, cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: Modest on the Flat; ordinary efforts both starts over hurdles; fifth at Limerick last time was a remote one; others preferred; declared to run on Flat at Navan 4.37 Sunday.

races.name: McNulty Furniture Rated Novice Hurdle

runners_data.name: Polepatrick
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning from 50-day break but won impressively last time and the step up to 2m4f should suit his staying pedigree.
runners_data.comment: Recent Clonmel comeback third augurs well; definite player
runners_data.spotlight: His second run back from an absence when breezing home at odds-on in a 2m soft-ground maiden at Tramore; he no doubt has plenty more to offer; this longer trip should be up his street.

runners_data.name: Chanceawetmorning
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with two recent wins for Gordon Elliott, quick turnaround suggests confidence and benefits from 5lb claiming allowance.
runners_data.comment: Unbeaten from two since joining this yard; up 7lb more but maybe this trip can unlock more
runners_data.spotlight: Has soon improved for Gordon Elliott in winning two 2m handicaps and the defeat upped to 2m4f at Listowel was no backward step; all those runs were on good to yielding, but handles soft; hard to knock.

runners_data.name: Berto Ramirez
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who improved significantly for switch to hurdles but faces tactical challenge against two prominent runners on testing ground.
runners_data.comment: Won readily at Down Royal, shaped as if he can continue on the upgrade on summer ground
runners_data.spotlight: Limited Flat maiden but doing better over hurdles and after winning his maiden at Down Royal he ran well at the weights in a rated hurdle at Wexford; has form claims for sure but this softer ground might not be preferable, especially over this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Polepatrick will dictate terms as the sole natural front-runner in this small field, with Chanceawetmorning likely to track close behind given his prominent style. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Polepatrick can control fractions throughout the 2m4f journey on yielding to soft ground. Berto Ramirez will need to be produced late from his hold-up position but faces the challenge of making up ground on testing conditions. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can travel kindly and have first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Polepatrick Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Polepatrick breaks well and faces no early pressure from the other prominent runner.
scenarios.body: He can dictate comfortable fractions and use his class edge, having won impressively last time despite a 50-day absence. The step up to 2m4f plays to his strengths and Mike O'Connor can time his effort perfectly from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Chanceawetmorning Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If Chanceawetmorning travels strongly in behind Polepatrick and finds extra stamina at the trip.
scenarios.body: His recent winning form for Gordon Elliott shows improved jumping and the 9-day turnaround suggests connections are confident. James Smith's 5lb claim helps significantly in a tight contest between these well-matched rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Berto Ramirez From Rear
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainably fast between the two prominent runners in the testing conditions.
scenarios.body: His hold-up style could prove advantageous if the leaders tie up, and he showed improved form when winning at Down Royal before running well in a rated hurdle. The 3lb claim from Aidan Kelly provides additional assistance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprising Upset
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or tactical mishaps disrupt the expected running of the favourites.
scenarios.body: The small field increases the chance of incidents affecting the outcome, particularly with amateur jockeys aboard two runners. Any fallers or mistakes could dramatically alter the complexion.

watchPoints.text: Watch for any early jumping errors from Polepatrick as he leads, which could hand initiative to Chanceawetmorning.
Monitor how well Chanceawetmorning travels in behind the leader given his 9-day turnaround from last race.
Observe if Berto Ramirez can get into contention turning for home, as he needs the pace to collapse to be effective.
Check if the soft ground causes any stamina issues in the closing stages given this is the longest trip for two runners.
Watch for any confidence issues from the amateur jockeys aboard Chanceawetmorning and Berto Ramirez in a tactical finish.

races.name: Dermot Hughes Car Sales Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Stede Bonnet
runners_data.note: Leading prominent runner returning from 87-day break may find one too good despite class edge
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-bumper winner is 2-6 over hurdles; won a Tramore maiden hurdle on New Year's Day (2m1f, soft) and Ayr novice (2m, soft) the following month; failed to fire upped to 20.5f (soft) in the Martin Pipe at Cheltenham; off since and capable of better; not discounted.

runners_data.name: Billy Lee Swagger
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist needs strong pace to showcase finishing kick, recent Ballinrobe win boosts confidence
runners_data.comment: Ran better than bare result at Punchestown latest, best form on softer ground than this
runners_data.spotlight: Gained third win over timber when bolting up in 22.5f handicap at Ballinrobe (good) two weeks ago; rider's claim negates most of 9lb rise for that 8l win; ground versatile and should go well again.

runners_data.name: Sequoiaspirit
runners_data.note: Prominent style perfectly suited to likely race shape, mixed hurdles form but solid on Flat recently
runners_data.comment: Form to feature but he has been very quiet in two runs over hurdles this year
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner (including here) is 1-28 over hurdles; last two runs in this sphere poor but shaped well on the level at Killarney four weeks ago; just 1lb above sole hurdles win so place chance but hard to fancy for win purposes given his modest strike-rate.

runners_data.name: Dreal Deal
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse in good recent form but needs searching gallop to be effective
runners_data.comment: Creditable third of 17 in valuable veterans' contest at Haydock; chance on that form.
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran has rediscovered form in recent starts; fine third in veterans' handicap chase at Haydock (2m4f, good) in April; another solid effort in veteran's handicap chase at Ballinrobe latest (19.5f, good); rated 3lb lower over hurdles but hasn't won in this sphere since 2021.

runners_data.name: Rakki
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won maiden here, disappointing recent efforts but well-positioned tactically
runners_data.spotlight: Won his maiden hurdle here in September (15.5f, gd-yld); creditable run when second in a handicap hurdle at Punchestown in November; disappointed both starts since, including when beaten 30l at Punchestown on return from break in April; sharper for that and tongue-tie goes on now.

runners_data.name: Sir Allen
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical challenge, returning from long layoff via Flat success
runners_data.spotlight: 2-13 over timber; returned from mammoth layoff with decisive Flat win at Navan in March (1m6f, heavy); given time to get over those exertions and returns to hurdling off what may be a workable mark; could go well.

runners_data.name: Lisnagar Fortune
runners_data.note: Prominent runner struggling since stable switch, needs to rediscover old form
runners_data.spotlight: Punchestown bumper and maiden hurdle winner for Willie Mullins; 150-1 and tailed off on debut for this stable in Grade 3 Red Mills Hurdle at Gowran in February; off since and hard to know what to expect after that; watch.

runners_data.name: Simple Things
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare showing consistent form in defeat, well-handicapped but style may be wrong
runners_data.comment: Second at Bellewstown last month in second h'cap; in the mix with improvement
runners_data.spotlight: 4yo filly is 0-6 over hurdles but has races in her; runner up in mares' handicaps at Bellewstown (2m1f, yielding) and Wexford (2m4f, gd-yld) the last twice; nudged up another 3lb and not sure she wants testing ground; chance if the forecast rain misses.

runners_data.name: Eye Of A Tiger
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who has lost way since maiden win, needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Solid form in the first half of last season, out of form, unseated in a chase last week
runners_data.spotlight: Has lost her way since winning a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last August; beaten 24l in mares' handicap hurdle at Ballinrobe latest (2m, good); others arrive in better form.

runners_data.name: Avalo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form, won at Punchestown festival and suits likely race dynamics
runners_data.comment: Placed five times in a row in summer/autumn before poor run when last seen in Nov'
runners_data.spotlight: Gained second win over hurdles on return from a 168-day break in gutsy fashion at the Punchestown festival (2m, yielding) off 7lb lower; won his maiden over 2m4f so this longer trip fine but the forecast rain is a big concern (flopped both previous starts on soft).

runners_data.name: Ollie La Ba Ba
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits race shape but returning from 163-day layoff raises fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Bit to prove over fences (0-3) but well handicapped on hurdling exploits
runners_data.spotlight: Won second race over hurdles when landing a handicap at Listowel (2m2f, gd-yld) in September; below best twice since, in a handicap chase at Clonmel and a handicap hurdle on heavy at Limerick in December; off since and record fresh suggests he might need this run.

races.paceDynamic: Stede Bonnet will lead early from his prominent style, with Sequoiaspirit, Rakki, Avalo and Ollie La Ba Ba likely to track him in the first half. The pace should be steady rather than cutthroat given only one natural leader, allowing the prominent runners to settle without pressure. From the back marker positions, Billy Lee Swagger, Dreal Deal, Sir Allen, Simple Things and Eye Of A Tiger will need the race to unfold at a searching gallop to close their deficits. This measured early pace strongly favours prominent runners who can position handy and have first run on the leaders turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady through halfway allowing prominent runners to track comfortably
scenarios.body: The handy horses get first run turning for home while hold-up horses struggle to make ground from too far back. Sequoiaspirit, Rakki and Avalo can all quicken from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Stede Bonnet sets a strong pace or prominent runners press him early
scenarios.body: The searching gallop stretches the field and allows Billy Lee Swagger and Dreal Deal to close from the rear with their superior finishing kicks. Hold-up horses benefit from the stronger tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Stede Bonnet gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to close
scenarios.body: The Gordon Elliott-trained leader uses his class advantage to control the race from pillar to post. His recent layoff becomes irrelevant if no pressure is applied early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start or the favourites disappoint
scenarios.body: Eye Of A Tiger or Simple Things can benefit from a messy race where class doesn't tell. The inconsistent pace plays into the hands of horses with less to lose.

watchPoints.text: Billy Lee Swagger and Dreal Deal need to see a strong early gallop to have any realistic chance from their hold-up styles
Stede Bonnet's 87-day absence could tell in the finish despite his class advantage if pressed hard
Sequoiaspirit's positioning early will reveal connections' confidence after disappointing recent hurdles efforts
Sir Allen's fitness after 526-day hurdles absence remains a major question mark despite recent Flat success
Simple Things' ability to get competitive from her hold-up style depends entirely on pace development

races.name: McGowan Accountancy Services Novice Chase

runners_data.name: Workahead
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner with perfect chase debut form, carries 5lb penalty but class advantage should tell
runners_data.comment: Outclassed in the Champion Hurdle; yard does well with chasers so can run a big race
runners_data.spotlight: Rated 144 over hurdles; made perfect start to chasing career when lowering the colours of Supersundae in a novice at Wexford (2m, gd-yld); 5lb penalty for that but handles softer ground and the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Talk In The Park
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with most chase experience but poor 0-9 record over fences, 134 days since last run
runners_data.comment: 0-8 chasing but remains of interest back in handicap with cheekpieces now tried
runners_data.spotlight: The most experienced chaser in the field but is 0-9; beaten 11.5l off 125 in Navan handicap chase (2m4f, heavy) when last seen in December; goes well fresh but best form on good ground so wouldn't want to see much rain.

runners_data.name: Bannow Blaze
runners_data.note: Hold-up hurdler making second chase start after unseating on debut, best watched for market confidence
runners_data.comment: Consistent hurdler who was in good form for the most part of last year
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler rated 112 in that sphere; unseated at the first on chase debut at Tramore; best watched for now.

runners_data.name: Wild Bill Hickok
runners_data.note: Quality hold-up performer who won chase debut impressively, 7lb claimer reduces burden
runners_data.comment: Easy winner on chasing debut over C&D 9 days ago; can be a player today with more to come
runners_data.spotlight: Talented hurdler (rated 135); foot perfect start to chase career when landing a Wexford beginners' by 11l last month; proved no match for Workahead in novice chase back there on latest; supporting role likely again.

runners_data.name: Haveigotnewsforyou
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with jumping issues in both chase starts, hard to trust despite 97-day break
runners_data.comment: Tailed off back from a long absence and UR latest but Cobden rides now; check market
runners_data.spotlight: Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner rated 120 in that sphere; jumping issues both chase starts; beaten 63l in beginners at Gowran in January and unseated at Leopardstown latest in March; risky proposition for now.

runners_data.name: Reiki Revolution
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suited to race shape, unseated when behind Workahead last time but fresher now
runners_data.comment: Poor last twice over hurdles; has plenty to find on chasing debut with some of these
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner; 1-8 over hurdles and rated 112; was a long way behind when unseating two out on chase debut in the Wexford novice won by Workahead; likely up against it again here.

runners_data.name: Scalpnagoon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose jumping errors have cost him in previous chase starts, needs clean round
runners_data.comment: Rated 120, bad mistake two out proved costly at Down Royal on latest, player down in trip
runners_data.spotlight: 122 rated hurdler has shown ability in all three chase starts but jumping errors have held him back; beaten 11l when runner up behind Net Boy at Ballinrobe latest (2m1f, good); place claims again.

runners_data.name: Positive Energy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who has struggled since stable switch, beaten 56 lengths last time at 150-1
runners_data.comment: 1-17 over hurdles, heavy defeat on debut for this yard latest, best watched in first chase
runners_data.spotlight: Flat and maiden hurdle winner for Michael O'Callaghan; hard to fancy on the back of two runs for this stable; beaten 56l when 150-1 in Ballinrobe beginners' chase latest.

races.paceDynamic: Workahead will make the running from the outset with no other confirmed pace angles in this field. Talk In The Park and Scalpnagoon may track in second and third early, but neither are aggressive pace forcers. The lack of early speed will create a pedestrian gallop through the early stages before the tempo lifts approaching the business end. This tactical setup strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as the soft ground will punish those who go too early in what becomes a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Workahead gets an easy lead and controls the tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The proven front-runner can dictate fractions and kick clear when ready, making full use of his class advantage. His perfect chase debut form gives him every chance to repeat the dose over similar conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow early and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks on the testing ground. Wild Bill Hickok's class and Reiki Revolution's fresh legs could prove decisive in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the leader or main fancies make crucial mistakes at key fences
scenarios.body: The race opens up for a horse who jumps cleanly throughout the contest. Talk In The Park's experience over fences becomes the decisive factor despite his poor strike rate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders all underperform or encounter trouble in running
scenarios.body: A lesser-rated horse who handles conditions perfectly springs a surprise at rewarding odds. Bannow Blaze bounces back from his unseating debut to show his true ability.

watchPoints.text: Bannow Blaze's jumping after unseating at the first fence on chase debut - any early mistake rules him out completely
Workahead's jumping under pressure if challenged - needs to maintain his perfect fencing record to justify favoritism
Talk In The Park's fitness after 134-day layoff despite going well fresh in the past
Wild Bill Hickok's position turning in - needs to be within striking distance to use his proven finishing kick
Market moves for Scalpnagoon or Reiki Revolution indicating stable confidence in their jumping improvement

races.name: Bet With Tote.ie On Racing & Sports Connacht National Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Rocky's Diamond
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits this tactical setup perfectly, classy hurdler adapting well to chasing with bright recent form
runners_data.spotlight: Classy hurdler made a bright start to his chasing career with a beginners' win at Galway (2m2f, gd-yld) followed by listed chase second at Wexford (2m7f, gd-yld); came up short in a grade 2 novice chase at Punchestown in November; poor back over hurdles the last twice and now makes handicap chase debut after 137 days off; market can guide.

runners_data.name: Killaney King
runners_data.note: Prominent runner faces traffic dangers, Henry De Bromhead yard in good form but yet to win under Rules
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner yet to score under Rules but placed on multiple occasions, including when a good second on final start for Henry De Bromhead at Fairyhouse in April (24.5f, yld-sft); just 1lb higher now and can't be discounted on first start for new stable.

runners_data.name: Hermino AA
runners_data.note: Prominent style risky in large field, 0-8 chase record is concerning despite useful hurdles form
runners_data.comment: Below best form in four chase starts for this yard and has to stage a revival
runners_data.spotlight: Useful three-time winning hurdler in Britain; yet to show much since joining this yard and extended chase record to 0-8 when beaten 31l in the Killarney National last time; 2lb drop in the weights and new blinkers not enough to tempt.

runners_data.name: Where's My Jet
runners_data.note: Natural leader will ensure honest pace, but 0-8 chase record and tendency to pull hard are major negatives
runners_data.comment: Penultimate Leopardstown run was decent but others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden and novice hurdle winner is 0-8 over fences and yet to finish in the first three; didn't run too badly in grade 3 handicap at the DRF in February but beaten 45l and pulled up both starts since; stamina to prove for this trip too; others preferred.

runners_data.name: A Penny A Hundred
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse perfectly suited to race shape, 191 days off is concern but Mullins stable in form
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed credentials for a race of this nature when a 12l third of 15 in the Mayo National at Ballinrobe last year off 132; ordinary form on last three starts last autumn and off the track since but now 3lb lower than she was at Ballinrobe and she needs checking in the market on return for top yard.

runners_data.name: Dorking Cock
runners_data.note: Prominent runner at 12 years old faces stamina test, first reserve with 4lb penalty makes task harder
runners_data.comment: Ran well at times in defeat in points and hunter chases last season; has to do much better
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; 3-20 over fences but no win of any description under Rules since November 2023; soundly beaten in Downpatrick hunter chase on latest; 4lb wrong here and others preferred.

runners_data.name: Kings Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent soft ground form, won last time on heavy and stays trip strongly
runners_data.comment: 9-2 fav, beaten 10l when third in Ladies National at Fairyhouse (2m5f); reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Best form on soft and heavy ground; won a novice handicap chase at Limerick in March (2m2f, heavy) off 117; stayed on for a 10l third of 17 over 2m5f (yld-sft) at Fairyhouse in April off revised mark of 124; worth another go at this sort of trip and the more rain that falls the better his chance will be.

runners_data.name: Ambitious Fellow
runners_data.note: Patient runner suited to pace scenario, but 0-11 chase record despite being second in this race last year
runners_data.comment: Only beaten 7l in Champion Hunters Chase at Punchestown where he was a huge price
runners_data.spotlight: 4-16 over hurdles but yet to win over the bigger obstacles (0-11); out of sorts this year but he was a 1.25l runner up in this race last year off this mark at 25-1 and he was running a better race when unseating at Listowel last time.

runners_data.name: Tonaghneave Well
runners_data.note: Hold-up style helps but poor chase form (0-5) suggests fences remain a problem
runners_data.comment: Course winner; useful hurdler but hasn't matched that form over fences; 196 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time winning hurdler rated 10lb higher in that sphere but that is for a reason; heavy defeats in all five chase starts and best form on good ground so the forecast rain is a worry; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Bartlemy Boy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good hunter chase form, handicap debut off potentially lenient mark
runners_data.comment: Favourite when second in this last year; well held in a couple of hunter chases this year
runners_data.spotlight: Prolific point-to-pointer (5-11); won a Listowel hunter chase on latest, his second win under rules; trip and ground should be fine on his handicap debut but tricky to assess whether he's well treated off this mark; probably up against it.

runners_data.name: Prince Palace
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying 4lb penalty as second reserve, recent form suggests confidence is low
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; 4lb wrong; won listed novice handicap at Navan last year but has lost way; pulled up in three of six starts since seasonal return in October; beaten 26l on first run for this stable at Leopardstown in March; risky proposition.

runners_data.name: Goody Four Shoes
runners_data.note: Prominent style risky in traffic, recent maiden win suggests improvement but big step up in class
runners_data.comment: Ran okay in both beginners' chases; 9-1 for h'cap bow over C&D, fell 4 out when in front
runners_data.spotlight: Shed the maiden tag on fourth chase start in a Down Royal handicap last month (3m2f, good); 5lb rise for that seems fair but this is a much tougher race and has to prove effectiveness on softer ground.

runners_data.name: Will Do
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with concerning recent form, 0-16 chase record despite smart hurdles performances
runners_data.comment: Porterstown second was good but major improvement needed on recent efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper and hurdles winner is 0-16 over fences; has run some smart races in defeat in valuable handicaps but has pulled up in three of his last four starts so comes with plenty of risks attached now; on a dangerous mark if rediscovers best.

runners_data.name: Smallcraftwarning
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse as third reserve, solid staying form but carrying 4lb penalty makes task harder
runners_data.comment: 8lb wrong and outclassed in Killarney National latest, this easier, could rebound
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; won at Killarney (2m7f, yld-sft) last summer off 91 and posted some fine efforts in defeat subsequently; not a bad effort at Limerick on latest but 12lb wrong here and this looks too demanding.

runners_data.name: Boston Rover
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent chase form (3-5), long absence since March is only concern
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to win over timber but better over fences, winning three from five starts including a 2m5f (good) beginners' here; won on handicap chase debut at Gowran last October off 125 (2m4f, yielding) before pulled up off revised mark of 134 in the Munster National (3m, yld-sft) in October; off since and could do with the track drying out.

runners_data.name: Pride Of Place
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades in finish, excellent Killarney National win but 9lb rise makes life tough
runners_data.comment: Struggled in softer ground after wins last year; could do better back on a sound surface
runners_data.spotlight: Had been out of sorts on soft ground earlier this year but roared back to top form when bolting up in the Killarney National a month ago (3m2f, gd-yld); 9lb rise for that seems fair but may not get his favoured underfoot conditions for last year's winning yard.

runners_data.name: Rocky's Howya
runners_data.note: Natural leader in great form (4-5 wins), only 3lb rise for Limerick win makes him very dangerous
runners_data.comment: Won a claiming hurdle at Clonmel 13 days ago, faces a stiff task at these weights.
runners_data.spotlight: 1-7 over fences; has won four of last five starts, including his last run in a handicap chase at Limerick in March (2m7f, heavy); just 3lb higher here and advertised well-being with a claiming hurdle win at Clonmel 25 days ago (19.5f, gd-yld); not out of this.

runners_data.name: Harbour Highway
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good spring form, recent Leopardstown win suggests he handles big fields well
runners_data.comment: Leopardstown winner in March, shaped like this trip might suit on latest, rain a worry
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner; in good form this spring bar a blip when pulled up on soft ground at Fairyhouse; won at Leopardstown in March (21.5f, yld) and then runner up at Kilbeggan (2m4f, gd-yld) and Limerick (24.5f, good); 2lb wrong here but rider's claim negates that; cheekpieces added; forecast rain is a concern.

runners_data.name: Born Bright
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid handicap form, 6lb rise from Market Rasen win keeps him competitive
runners_data.comment: Dual hurdles winner added two chase victories over fences last summer; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Won three races last year, including handicap chases at Tipperary (2m7f, yielding) and Market Rasen (3m, good); is 6lb higher than for that latter win; shaped nicely on return from a break over hurdles at Wexford 23 days ago but soft ground would be a big concern for her.

races.paceDynamic: Where's My Jet and Rocky's Howya are confirmed pace-pushers who will contest the early lead, ensuring an honest gallop from the start. The large field features 8 runners wanting prominent positions (Killaney King, Hermino AA, Dorking Cock, Bartlemy Boy, Goody Four Shoes, Will Do, Boston Rover, Harbour Highway), creating inevitable traffic problems and scrimmaging from 3 out. Over this stamina-sapping 3m1f trip on soft ground with two genuine front-runners, the pace will be searching throughout. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early burn-up and traffic chaos, picking off tired leaders in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong between Where's My Jet and Rocky's Howya
scenarios.body: The soft ground and 3m1f trip will find out the early pace-setters, allowing patient hold-up performers to sweep past exhausted leaders. Horses like Rocky's Diamond, Kings Hill, and A Penny A Hundred can avoid the traffic and time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners set a moderate tempo allowing prominent horses to stay close
scenarios.body: Boston Rover or Bartlemy Boy can track the pace without over-exertion and kick clear when the leaders weaken. Their ability to sit handy without being caught in traffic gives them the tactical edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Rocky's Howya gets an easy lead with Where's My Jet pulling too hard early
scenarios.body: Rocky's Howya's proven stamina and excellent recent form allows him to dictate terms and hold on grimly. His 4 wins from 5 starts suggests he knows how to close out races when in front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Causes Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates a messy, stop-start pace with multiple fallers or interference
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with those getting clear runs benefiting most. Horses drawn well or ridden patiently like Tonaghneave Well could sneak through for places.

watchPoints.text: Where's My Jet and Rocky's Howya will set a fierce early pace that could collapse if both pull too hard in the first mile
Traffic chaos is inevitable from 3 out with 8 prominent runners converging on limited racing room in a 19-runner field
Boston Rover faces fitness concerns after 232 days off despite his excellent chase record when fresh
Rocky's Diamond's jumping under pressure will be tested for the first time in this level of competitive handicap company
Pride Of Place's tendency to fade in the finish could be exposed over this stamina-sapping trip on testing ground

races.name: Sweeney Oil Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Moylussa
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with sustainable pace-setting style, 13 days since last run keeps him fresh
runners_data.comment: No win since 2024, not a bad run penultimate, didn't back it up latest, others more solid
runners_data.spotlight: A winner over hurdles and now goes chasing on the back of a 2l third in a 2m handicap at Ballinrobe; handles soft ground and he has a pointing background.

runners_data.name: Soldante
runners_data.note: Fellow front-runner who can press Moylussa early, returns from 32-day break under claiming rider
runners_data.comment: Recent Tramore third was encouraging on only second chase start; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced since winning his maiden hurdle in 2023; has returned from a long absence with three competitive runs over fences, the last two both handicaps; trip/ground fine; on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Stoneyford Lady
runners_data.note: Prominent tracker for top trainer, 45-day gap a concern but has strong chase form when jumping well
runners_data.comment: Won at Thurles on her second chase start, bad mistake two out at Limerick was costly
runners_data.spotlight: 6lb higher than for her win in a 2m2f handicap chase at Thurles but was running well when clouting two out next time; latest run needs forgiving but she has a big effort in her.

runners_data.name: Keep On Dreaming
runners_data.note: Prominent style suited to this trip, making handicap debut after point-to-point background
runners_data.spotlight: 2-6 in points and 0-4 in hunter chases, with all that form at trips between 2m6f and 3m1f; hard to know how he'll fare over this far in his first handicap and there have to be concerns.

runners_data.name: Piccolo Player
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making chase debut off competitive hurdle form, 13 days keeps him sharp
runners_data.comment: Raised 1lb for Kilbeggan second latest, yard has good record here, place claims
runners_data.spotlight: Won his maiden hurdle on heavy ground and has since been competitive off this sort of mark; now goes over fences and there are chasers in the family.

runners_data.name: Presenting Lad
runners_data.note: Experienced hold-up performer with proven chase form, just 10 days since runner-up effort
runners_data.comment: C&D winner in 2024, out of form last year, below best after break latest, revival needed
runners_data.spotlight: Six wins include two over fences and was runner-up at Tramore ten days ago on good ground; handles these conditions.

runners_data.name: Must Go Now
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendency in finishes, recent Fairyhouse hurdle win shows current form
runners_data.comment: 1-17 over hurdles and rated 109, well beaten sole previous chase start, others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Fairyhouse handicap hurdle (2m4f, yielding to soft) in early 2025 but only one effort of note in the past 12 months, when third in first-time cheekpieces at Cork in March; tailed off in both his beginners' chases.

runners_data.name: Donnrua Dream
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying light weight, poor jumping record over fences remains major concern
runners_data.comment: Enjoys it around here, with a hurdles win in February; didn't stay last time; player
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner but yet to deliver over fences (0-9) despite being strong in the betting on occasions; jumped moderately 18 days ago.

runners_data.name: Katherine
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare making belated chase return, last week's hurdle effort hard to assess literally
runners_data.comment: 3-28 over hurdles and rated 98, out of form, would be a surprise winner
runners_data.spotlight: Ran surprisingly well behind the classy Murcia in a mares' hurdle last week, but on balance of form it's hard to take that effort literally; this is a belated return to fences (0-5).

runners_data.name: Struck Oil
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making only second chase start, showed promise on debut despite disappointing finish
runners_data.comment: Second over hurdles last time; one to consider on chasing debut with the market a guide
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo was who runner-up in his final handicap over hurdles (2m1f; 2lb lower); sent off favourite for chase debut off this mark at Downpatrick and ran okay to be beaten 13l into third having jumped deliberately; if sharper for that experience he can go well.

runners_data.name: Chosen Shant
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with strong hurdle form, chase record lacks substance but well-handicapped
runners_data.comment: Went back-to-back at Wexford last summer; has struggled since but better ground will help
runners_data.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicap hurdles at Wexford last summer; chase form (0-6) lacks substance but she's potentially well in given hurdling exploits.

runners_data.name: Party President
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendency, pulled up on recent chase debut raises serious doubts
runners_data.comment: Lost form since back-to-back hurdles win last year, new yard, chase debut, watch
runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner but signed off for Tony Mullins on a low note and was pulled up on recent stable/chase debut.

runners_data.name: Spanish Maid
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare finally off the mark over fences, recent double success suggests confidence high
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark over fences at the ninth attempt in a 1m7f handicap at Tramore (in cheekpieces) and then narrowly followed up back over hurdles (no headgear); higher mark to contend with but she's a thriving mare with a feather weight.

runners_data.name: L'Amiral Fromentin
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with limited experience, soft ground represents unknown quantity for connections
runners_data.comment: Good third at Tramore before sixth in better race at Wexford; 5yo can keep improving
runners_data.spotlight: Only had the eight races, seven of those over fences; knocking on the door but has questions to answer on this slower ground.

races.paceDynamic: Moylussa and Soldante will dictate the early pace from the front, with Stoneyford Lady and Keep On Dreaming tracking in prominent positions. The soft ground and 2m½f trip suggests a steady gallop rather than breakneck speed, allowing the multiple hold-up horses to get into contention. The lack of genuine speed horses means this will develop into a staying test from the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent trackers who can quicken late, rather than early leaders who may find little cover.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady and the race becomes a sprint from the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up brigade will pay dividends as they swamp the tiring leaders in the closing stages. Horses like Piccolo Player, Presenting Lad and Must Go Now can use their finishing kicks to full effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Moylussa and Soldante set a genuine gallop that stretches the field
scenarios.body: The prominent runners who track the pace will be perfectly positioned to strike when the leaders weaken. Stoneyford Lady and Keep On Dreaming can use their tactical positions to time their challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Moylussa gets an uncontested lead and the pace is very sedate throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate completely and have enough left for the finish. Moylussa's stamina reserves prove decisive in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the soft ground or jumping errors occur
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted hold-up horse who handles the conditions perfectly can emerge from the pack. The handicapper's dream scenario where class doesn't tell.

watchPoints.text: Moylussa and Soldante could go too fast early and collapse, opening the door for patient hold-up horses
Stoneyford Lady's jumping accuracy after 45-day break, as clouting fences has been her recent downfall
Must Go Now and Party President both show fading tendencies in finishes that could prove costly again
Donnrua Dream's jumping technique early on, as poor jumping has plagued all nine chase attempts to date
The pace through the first half-mile will determine whether front-runners or hold-up horses benefit most

races.name: Roscommon (Q.R.) Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Global Assembly
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 364-day break with poor recent pointing form and struggles with regulation fences
runners_data.comment: New headgear combination tried here but likely to find one too good
runners_data.spotlight: 0-8 over regulation fences and this year's pointing exploits are nothing to shout about, last time finishing well behind Revolut Ned.

runners_data.name: Cavalry Master
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who typically fades in the finish, veteran form well below peak with concerning stamina doubts
runners_data.comment: Veteran six-time winner, a shadow of his former self in points and cross-country races
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper/hurdle/chase winner but a veteran now and nothing like the force of old; opposable.

runners_data.name: Jouster
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse showing revival signs for new trainer Flynn, tongue-tie fitted and progressive profile suggests more to come
runners_data.comment: Useful mark and some signs of a revival when fourth at Downpatrick
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdle/chase winner for Gavin Cromwell before losing his way; some signs of a revival for his new yard, latterly behind a sharp improver at Tramore; a tongue-tie returns with new blinkers added.

runners_data.name: Kilkee Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with underwhelming chase record, blinkers return suggests connections trying to spark improvement
runners_data.comment: In sixth when unseated rider at Killarney 10 days ago behind Oneforgonzo; local trainer
runners_data.spotlight: Couldn't win over hurdles for Gordon Elliott; it's been an underwhelming start over fences and others have more pressing claims; the return of blinkers doesn't look significant.

runners_data.name: Ballagh Star
runners_data.note: Prominent type who wants further than this trip, tailed off over hurdles last time but much better over fences
runners_data.comment: Dual winning chaser is rated 8lb lower over hurdles but is 0-14; may need this run
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off after a break last month but that was over hurdles and chasing is more his game; chance on his competitive form last autumn but wants further ideally.

runners_data.name: Finnicky Filly
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare in decent form but untested at this distance, strong trainer record and versatile over obstacles
runners_data.comment: 1-22 hurdles record in a negative, unplaced twice since a pleasing C&D second in April
runners_data.spotlight: Hard to win with but not in bad form by any means, over fences and hurdles; being unraced over this far is a likely negative.

runners_data.name: Revolut Ned
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent third at Tramore, relatively young at seven and improving chase profile
runners_data.comment: Recent point winner; others have more pressing claims when this is his handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: After winning a point he ran a solid third in a 2m6f handicap at Tramore nine days ago, beaten 7l by a well-backed winner; only a 7yo and considered.

runners_data.name: Silent Flight
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran who fades in finish, poor recent form over fences and back to hurdles suggests struggling
runners_data.comment: Heavy-ground winner over 2m4f at this venue in January 2024, out of sorts last year
runners_data.spotlight: Won over hurdles in early 2024; offered little in four runs over fences before another heavy defeat back hurdling.

runners_data.name: Rideau Canal
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won in heavy ground at Tramore in February but poor form since across both codes
runners_data.comment: Belatedly off mark over fences in Feb'; reverts to hurdles but 0-21 record is off-putting
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 2m5f handicap chase in the mud at Tramore in February but nothing since over fences and hurdles.

runners_data.name: The Rebel County
runners_data.note: Hold-up type beaten 18 lengths last week, cheekpieces applied but slim pickings since hunter chase win
runners_data.comment: Hunter chase winner 12 months ago but slim pickings since then and cheekpieces now go on
runners_data.spotlight: Fairly slim pickings since winning a hunter chase more than a year ago; beaten 18l last week; tried in cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Kilashee
runners_data.note: Front runner better over hurdles than fences, 191 days since last run but back off correct handicap mark
runners_data.comment: Better hurdler than chaser, 12lb wrong here, hard to fancy despite rider's 7lb claim
runners_data.spotlight: Better hurdler than chaser; she is at least back off her correct mark this time but wouldn't be the percentage call; now an 11yo.

runners_data.name: Ta Se Rua
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose latest hunter chase third was remote, 13-year-old veteran back in tougher company
runners_data.comment: Sprang a 33-1 shock in this race last year, likely to be available at big odds again
runners_data.spotlight: Point and hunter chase winner; latest third at Tramore (hunter chase) was quite remote; opposable back in a handicap.

runners_data.name: Eddies Pride
runners_data.note: Reserve hold-up mare who was tailed off at 80-1 last time, regressive 12-year-old with headgear changes
runners_data.comment: Both chase wins have been over further and hasn't won in over two years; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Reserve; regressive mare; 80-1 when tailed off in a Limerick handicap 18 days ago.

runners_data.name: Made U Look
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 130-day break after pointing success but unproven in rules company
runners_data.spotlight: His form in hunter chases isn't overly compelling and probably best watched on this return to rules action, despite winning his latest point.

runners_data.name: Stormy Master
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse close at Limerick on return from break but ground may be softer than ideal
runners_data.comment: Four-time chase winner; scored at Wexford last summer off 85; may need the run here
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time chase winner; veteran who was returning from a lengthy break when only 2l away at Limerick (2m6f, good) but this ground could be softer than he cares for.

runners_data.name: Bohemian Bay
runners_data.note: Young hold-up type tailed off over hurdles but pointing form suggests fences could suit better
runners_data.comment: Kept on for moderate fifth on h'cap bow but Limerick run was a step backwards
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in two handicaps over hurdles; his places in points suggest he may do better over fences and he's only a 6yo.

runners_data.name: Annie Questions
runners_data.note: Reserve hold-up mare recently off mark in points but was tailed off in regulation company two years ago
runners_data.spotlight: Reserve; belatedly off the mark in points last month; once placed over hurdles but two years ago and was tailed off in a handicap on previous run over regulation fences; hood added.

runners_data.name: Ballingurteen
runners_data.note: Hold-up type showing improvement in recent handicap hurdles with pointing second suggesting chase potential
runners_data.comment: Recent Limerick second should go well if handling these quicker conditions
runners_data.spotlight: Second in a point so could make a chaser and there's been definite improvement in her last two runs over hurdles, both handicaps at about 2m3f; could be interesting.

runners_data.name: Robin Elite
runners_data.note: Reserve hold-up horse struggling in chase handicaps with poor recent pointing form
runners_data.comment: In good hands but has been struggling in low-grade handicaps, up against it
runners_data.spotlight: Reserve; has struggled in handicap chases and recent pointing exploits do not bode well.

races.paceDynamic: Kilashee is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a reasonable gallop without pressure in the early stages. With most of the field adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, there's no pace pressure on the leader through the middle stages. The soft ground and 2m5½f trip will test stamina in the final half-mile, particularly as the pace lifts approaching the home turn. This setup strongly favours patient hold-up horses who can stay the trip and finish strongly, as they'll have plenty of pace to aim at without being forced into early efforts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kilashee sets reasonable fractions and the pace builds gradually through the race
scenarios.body: The patient types get the perfect tow and can unleash their finishing kicks up the hill, while early leaders tire on the testing ground. Horses like Revolut Ned, Jouster and Finnicky Filly are perfectly positioned to strike late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian and tactical in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The horses tracking the leader can kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized, capitalizing on their forward positions. Made U Look and Ballagh Star can use their chase experience to time their moves perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kilashee Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the ground rides slower than expected and stamina becomes paramount
scenarios.body: The leader's uncontested lead proves decisive as others struggle to make up ground in the heavy conditions. Kilashee's staying power and tactical advantage overcome her recent poor form as the field comes back to her late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Kilashee goes too slowly and creates a sprint finish from the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace sets up a bunched field turning for home where anything can happen. Fresh legs and luck in running become crucial as form goes out the window in a cavalry charge.

watchPoints.text: Kilashee sets the pace from the front but returns from 191 days off and may not stay the trip under pressure
Cavalry Master and Silent Flight both carry fade-in-finish warnings and may weaken badly if the pace is strong
Made U Look returns from 130 days off having only run in hunter chases, potentially needing the run back in rules company
Several reserves including Eddies Pride and Annie Questions could get a run if withdrawals occur on soft ground
The ground reports show consistent yielding-to-soft conditions throughout the card, favoring proven soft ground performers

races.name: Roscommon Livestock Mart (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners_data.name: Linford
runners_data.comment: By a leading French sire and maximum respect from this yard especially if strong in market
runners_data.spotlight: 9-4 favourite when comfortably pulling 10l clear at Killarney (good to yielding); that form has yet to be tested but this 4yo looked good and probably has a bright future.

runners_data.name: Coolnagrattan
runners_data.comment: Dam 9.5f/10.4f winner (RPR 75); headgear combo suggests he's a keen-going sort
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise when fourth at Punchestown (good to yielding; in this headgear combination) but the RPR was modest.

runners_data.name: Fleu Du Glaye
runners_data.comment: By a useful sire and cost Eur30,000 as a 3yo; likely to improve from this; tongue-tie
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 18l by Linford at Killarney and there's no clear reason why he should be reversing those placings.

runners_data.name: Caislean Gear
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam unraced half-sister to smart French/US middle-distance performer Rhythm Mad and 1m3f Flat and 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase winner No Greater Love; likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Familiar Game
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to Greek/Polish 5f/6f winner; yard 11-94 in bumpers last five seasons
runners_data.spotlight: Cost only 2,600gns as 3yo; second foal; half-brother to Greek/Polish 5f/6f winner Mollys Pride; dam 6f/7f maiden (RPR 68); wouldn't be the obvious answer.

runners_data.name: Skylab
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam runner-up first of two starts in bumpers, out of 1m winning half-sister to Listed-placed dams of Group 1 winners Qemah (French 1m), Ask Victor More (Japanese 1m7f) and Pretty Gorgeous (1m 2yo); the market should be enlightening with the yard also represented by Linford.

runners_data.name: Hilly Filly
runners_data.spotlight: 16,000euros 3yo; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Fascile Mode (useful bumper and 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase) and C'Est Rien (2m7f chase); dam 2m4f hurdle winner; bred to have a future.

runners_data.name: Tell The Boys
runners_data.comment: Promise on debut, even better at Cork latest, form has been boosted, leading claims
runners_data.spotlight: Confirmed previous promise when winning in a canter at Listowel (good to yielding; second run in a hood) and in receipt of weight she might well give Linford something to think about; tongue-tie added.

runners_data.name: Knocknasuff
runners_data.comment: Flat-bred was a Eur3,000 vendor buyback as a yearling; one to watch on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 100-1 and completely tailed off in Linford's race at Killarney.
